build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search parameters
build_task_scene: build a physics puzzle scene with a table, slope, ball, cover, and goal container
add_box_object: add a static box object to the PHYRE scene using vt.add_box with dimensions and flip options
add_convex_polygon_slope: add a convex polygon slope to the scene using C.add_convex_polygon with converted vertices
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with radius and position parameters
